feature: The one-line card row (card rows addendum L1), the glint under the dot or in its place, the marks folding by the row's width, and the Shopping key
note: The foil mark's PR 2 (plan `2026-10-15-foil-mark.md`) drew a two-line row; the card rows addendum (L1, Hugh 2026-10-16) put every card row back on one 34px line from md in All and Shopping, folding marks by the row's own width (`@container` on the row's wrapper) and fixing the right-hand columns. Below md the phone keeps its rows: the All row as shipped and Shopping's option B, with the glint under the dot. Photographed at 390, 800, 900 and 1300: 800 and 900 are the two-column grid at its narrowest, where the wide, middle and tight tiers all show, and 1300 is the wide one.\n\nPRECONDITION: the sheet account must own a foil card in the deck (`FOIL_CARD`, set to every-copy-foil on a scratch branch) or no glint is drawn and the sheet reads as coverage. The deck must hold a card priced over its limit (the Shopping cell scrolls to a row carrying the stand-ins press), and a card with a bracket mark (the `marks` rows scroll to one; a card with two or more shows the middle tier too); a row that cannot find its target fails rather than photographing something else. A scratch branch of local-dev is the right database (set the finish on the scratch copy only). The first cell of a run lands on the Welcome page (the About gate marks itself seen on that visit); the first row's two throwaway visits absorb it.

shares.note: The row draws the glint as-is; the key draws FoilMark (foil-mark-key.json).

rows.label: /decks/[id] All, one 34px line: the glint in the filled dot's place, the name and marks, the price, the pip track and the ✕ in fixed columns
/decks/[id] All, List view on the phone: the shipped row (name over pips), the glint at the head of its meta line, under the dot, pips at the name's x
/decks/[id] Shopping, one 34px line from md (option B below it): marker, ⇄, the 84px buy tag with `over $N` folded into its outline, the ✕
/decks/[id] Shopping: a foil card that is short (so Shopping lists it), the glint in the dot's place from md and under it on the phone, pips at the name's x below md
/decks/[id] All: a row with a bracket mark, the mark folding into +N in the tight tier (the two-column grid at 800 and 900 is tight; 1300 is wide, so it stays)
/decks/[id] Shopping: a row with two or more bracket marks, every mark folded into +N at the middle tier and the marker's word to its glyph
